headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 30, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory, while Ronald Acuña Jr. led the Braves' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Los Angeles Dodgers' Blake Snell, who was transferred to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow loose bodies. Teoscar Hernández was also placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain. The Detroit Tigers' Brant Hurter was transferred to the 60-day injured list due to lumbar spine inflammation, while Casey Mize was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 28 with a right adductor inflammation.

The Detroit Tigers made a trade, sending RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, while the Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in South Side Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 6-2 loss to the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk leading the Twins' offense with 3 RBIs on a single hit in 4 at-bats. Davis Martin earned the win for the White Sox, pitching 6 strong innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. Ronald Acuña Jr. led the Braves' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Reds in 8-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-3 win. Ronald Acuña Jr. and Michael Harris II led the Braves' offense, contributing to the team's decisive victory.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Nationals 7-5**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 7-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Fernando Tatis Jr. and Gavin Sheets contributing to the winning effort.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Blake Snell Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers left-handed pitcher Blake Snell has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to loose bodies in his left elbow. The move comes after he was initially placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Tigers Make Roster Move Ahead of Deadline**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. This move comes as the Tigers look to bolster their pitching staff before the MLB trade deadline.
